description:
**Style.cs:40** にて `//SetDisplay("keyword", LayoutType.Inline)` がコメントアウトされており、`keyword` タグが Block 扱いになっている。

意図的なコメントアウトかどうかを確認し、必要であれば有効化する。

参照: Tools/Lib/TODO.md (堅牢性改善 / Priority: Medium)

runs.result_output: Based on my analysis, the `keyword` tag is an inline semantic element (like `<a>`) — the parser creates it from `[name]` syntax within text, and the builder handles it identically to `<a>` anchors. Having it default to `Block` would break inline text flow. The comment-out was likely accidental, left over from early development. I'll uncomment it.Tests aren't available for the .NET standalone runner (the test project has no source files — tests live in Unity's `Tests/Editor/`). The change is straightforward: uncommenting `SetDisplay("keyword", LayoutType.Inline)` so `keyword` behaves as inline (matching `<a>`, `<span>`, etc.) instead of block. Now I'll update TODO.md.Now let me post the result comment and update the issue status.Done. Uncommented `SetDisplay("keyword", LayoutType.Inline)` in `Style.cs:42` — `keyword` is an inline semantic element (like `<a>`) generated by the parser from `[name]` syntax, and having it default to Block broke inline text flow. TODO.md updated accordingly. Set issue to `in_review`.

title: [TML] keyword タグの display がコメントアウト
